cp1:1.1: Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa. I -- PAṬHAMO
cp1:2.1: AKITTIVAGGO Kappe ca satasahasse caturo ca asaṅkheyye etthantare yaṃ caritaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ bodhipācanaṃ. || ||
cp1:3.1: Atītakappe caritaṃ ṭhapayitvā bhavābhave imamhi kappe caritaṃ pavakkhissaṃ suṇohi me. || || DĀNAPĀRAMITĀ
cp1:4.1: Yadā ahaṃ brahāraññe suññe vipinakānane ajjhogahetvā viharāmi Akitti nāma tāpaso || ||
cp1:5.1: Tadā maṃ tapatejena santatto tidivābhibhū dhārento brāhmaṇavaṇṇaṃ bhikkhāya maṃ upāgami. || ||
cp1:6.1: Pavanā ābhataṃ paṇṇaṃ atelañca aloṇikaṃ mama dvāre ṭhitaṃ disvā sakaṭāhena ākiriṃ. || ||
cp1:7.1: Tassa datvāna' haṃ paṇṇaṃ nikkujjitvāna bhājanaṃ pun' esanaṃ jahitvāna pāvisiṃ paṇṇasālakaṃ. || ||
cp1:8.1: Dutiyam-pi tatiyam-pi upagañchi mama' ntikaṃ akampito anolaggo evam-evam-adās' ahaṃ. || ||
cp1:9.1: Na me tappaccayā atthi sarīrasmiṃ vivaṇṇiyaṃ pītisukhena ratiyā vītināmemi taṃ divaṃ. || ||
cp1:10.1: Yadi māsam-pi dvemāsaṃ dakkhiṇeyyaṃ varaṃ labhe akampito anolīno dadeyyaṃ dānam-uttamaṃ. || ||
cp1:11.1: Na tassa dānaṃ dadamāno yasaṃ lābhañca patthayiṃ sabbaññutaṃ patthayāno tāni kammāni ācarin-ti. || ||
